awarding_body.detail: The live page is the awarding organisation's own: Camões - Instituto da Cooperação e da Língua, I.P., integrated in the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Portugal. Matches the record verbatim, including the Ministry of Foreign Affairs attribution.
awarding_body.quote: Camões – Instituto da Cooperação e da Língua, I.P. has in place a set of scholarship programmes within the framework of Portuguese Language and Culture

deadline.detail: The page quotes exactly the deadline the record carries - applications 5 to 18 May 2026 - but that cycle is closed: its provisional and definitive result lists were published in June 2026 and the notice states approved scholarships could only begin from September 2026. As of today (12 October 2026) the official page shows no open application cycle and no announcement of the next (2027) cycle, so the record cannot stand as an open opportunity. The deadline value is confirmed; the record's implicit 'currently open' claim is contradicted.
deadline.quote: Within the framework of the Research Scholarship Programme, applications are open from 5 to 18 May 2026 (until 5 p.m., Lisbon time).

eligibility.detail: All distinct eligibility claims in the record are confirmed by the official programme descriptions: course scholarships for 'foreign students and Portuguese citizens living abroad who wish to improve their language skills'; the Fernão Mendes Pinto Programme for 'foreign and Portuguese students either graduate or attending their final year of undergraduate studies'; and the Research Programme for 'teachers and researchers, both foreigners and Portuguese living abroad'. Nothing contradicts the record.
eligibility.quote: This programme is for teachers and researchers, both foreigners and Portuguese living abroad, who wish to undertake specialisation studies in the field of Portuguese language and culture in Portugal, namely master and PhD study programmes at Portuguese universities.

funding.detail: The record claims 'Fully Funded', but the awarding body's own 2026 notices describe a monthly allowance only, with tuition, travel and accommodation explicitly left to the scholarship holder: Research Programme receives '€990/month (maximum 11 monthly payments per year)'; in-person Summer Course receives a 'Monthly stipend – €1,150.00'; only the online Summer Course variant covers 'course registration/tuition fee'. That is a living stipend, not full funding - per the brief, even a tuition-only award is not fully funded.
funding.quote: Travel and accommodation costs are the responsibility of the scholarship holder. The scholarship holder is also responsible for tuition fees and registration at the higher education institution attended.

degree_levels.detail: The record's 'Undergraduate (final year), Master's, PhD' matches the official programme descriptions: Fernão Mendes Pinto is for students 'attending their final year of undergraduate studies'; the Research Programme covers 'master and PhD study programmes at Portuguese universities', with the notice fixing durations of two years for Master's and three years for PhD programmes.
degree_levels.quote: Research Program – Intended for foreign professors and researchers, as well as Portuguese nationals residing abroad, who wish to carry out in Portugal advanced studies in Portuguese language and culture, namely Master's and PhD Programs at Portuguese universities.

recommended_field_updates.deadline_text: Applications may be submitted between 5 and 18 May 2026 (until 17:00, Lisbon time). [2026 cycle - closed; results published]
recommended_field_updates.verification_notes: The Camões, I.P. site was restructured; the recorded /en/scholarships URL now 404s and the live pages sit under /en/activity-camoes/what-we-do/scholarships/scholarships-camoes-i-p/... . This is an annual programme family with a single spring application window (2026 cycle: 5-18 May 2026, 17:00 Lisbon time; historically the window opens around March-May and results are published within 30 working days). Funding is NOT full funding: Research Programme pays €990/month (max 11 monthly payments per year); in-person Summer Course pays €1,150/month; online Summer Course covers only the registration/tuition fee. In every variant except the online summer course, tuition, travel and accommodation are the scholarship holder's own responsibility. As of the check date (2026-10-12) the 2026 cycle has closed with definitive results published and no 2027 cycle has been announced - re-check in spring 2027 for the next cycle.

notes_for_reviewer: A human should decide three things. (1) Status: the record is marked active but the only currently-documented cycle closed on 18 May 2026 with results published; no cycle is open on 12 October 2026, so the record should not be presented as currently applicable. (2) Funding: 'Fully Funded' is contradicted by the awarding body's own notices (monthly stipends; tuition/travel/accommodation on the holder) and should be corrected to a partial/stipend description. (3) The record bundles a programme family (Summer Course, Annual Course, Fernão Mendes Pinto, Research, Pessoa, Vieira) whose amounts and coverage differ per programme (e.g., online Summer Course covers registration/tuition only), so a single 'Fully Funded' label cannot be right for any of them as a set.
